tools.name: list_certifications
tools.description: List every ServiceNow certification exam (CSA, CAD, CPOA, CIS-*) with its exam code, level, exam format and SNReady practice link.

tools.name: get_exam_blueprint
tools.description: Exam blueprint for one ServiceNow certification: domains with their weight in the exam and their objectives, cost, prerequisites, the cut-score note, question count and duration where ServiceNow publishes them, and the official ServiceNow blueprint link.

tools.name: get_practice_questions
tools.description: Random practice questions for a ServiceNow certification exam, optionally from one blueprint domain, with the correct answers, explanations for every option and ServiceNow documentation links. Use this to quiz someone preparing for a ServiceNow exam.

tools.name: get_release_calendar
tools.description: ServiceNow family release dates (Zurich, Australia, ...), end of support dates and certification delta exam windows, including which delta windows are open today. Includes a subscribable .ics calendar link.
